overview_description.description: Rubrik offers live data access for recovery and application development by fusing enterprise data management with web-scale IT and eliminating backup software. about_short_description.short_description: Rubrik is a data security platform that delivers cyber resilience, cyber posture, and cyber recovery solutions.

product.name: Rubrik Security Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based data security and management platform for protecting, monitoring, and recovering data across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.

product.name: Rubrik Data Protection
product.description: Data protection software that discovers, classifies, monitors, and protects sensitive data across enterprise environments to support recovery and compliance.

product.name: Rubrik Cyber Recovery
product.description: A recovery solution for restoring business data and applications after ransomware or other cyber incidents using clean recovery points and automated recovery workflows.

product.name: Rubrik Agent Cloud
product.description: An AI-agent security platform for inventorying agents, applying runtime controls, monitoring actions, and reversing harmful agent activity.

product.name: Rubrik Identity Recovery
product.description: Identity protection and recovery capabilities for monitoring identity providers, securing non-human identities, and restoring clean identity states after compromise.

product.name: Rubrik SaaS Data Protection
product.description: Backup and recovery protection for data stored in software-as-a-service applications, helping organizations preserve and restore SaaS data.
